image_description: A close-up shot of two spoonbills interacting. The primary subject on the left is a Roseate Spoonbill, characterized by pink plumage on the wings and body, white neck, and a distinctive greenish-yellow face with an orange eye. Its bill is long, flat, and spatulate at the tip, appearing pale grey/ivory with some dark mottling near the base. The secondary subject on the right is likely a juvenile or different species (possibly a White Spoonbill or immature Roseate), featuring predominantly white plumage and a yellowish-orange bill. They are perched among blurred branches with green foliage in the background.
